topic.source_contract: Local Nature Recovery Strategy areas, responsible authorities, maps, priorities and planning regard

facts.LNRS: spatial strategies required under the Environment Act 2021
facts.planning: public authorities must have regard to relevant LNRS
facts.guard: mapped opportunity is not a site designation or funded delivery commitment

facts.statutory_guidance: local habitat map and written biodiversity priorities
facts.guard: responsible authorities may justify departures from guidance

facts.coverage: 48 areas cover England without gaps or overlaps
facts.status: publication status and responsible authorities are updated
facts.guard: national status list must be checked for currency

facts.delivery: locally led proposals require partner action
facts.guard: strategy proposal is not landowner consent or implementation

facts.procedure: preparation, consultation, publication, review and republication procedure
facts.guard: procedural compliance and site delivery are distinct

scope_guards: An LNRS opportunity area is not treated as a statutory environmental designation.
A mapped proposal is not treated as landowner agreement.
A biodiversity priority is not treated as funded or implemented delivery.
Having regard to an LNRS is not treated as an automatic planning outcome.
Draft and published strategy versions are not mixed.
LNRS, BNG, protected-site law and local-plan policy are kept separate.
Map resolution is not treated as exact parcel geometry without intersection evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact strategy version, parcel relation, measure, agreement, funding and delivery.
